subject: Align on evaluation kickoff + prompt workshop
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@healthplus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: propose eval kickoff + prompt workshop

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call: HealthPlus is prioritizing automated triage for intake forms and improving suggested coding/notes for clinicians. You mentioned latency cost concerns for long visit notes and a desire to validate accuracy on a set of 200 representative notes.

Suggested next steps to get you into an evaluation rapidly:
- 60–75 min evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + confirm success criteria)
- 90 min prompt workshop where our ML engineer walks through a small prompt pack and we co-create failure cases
- Delivery of a 2-week pilot plan with a 200-note prompt set and quantitative success metrics

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:15
- Wed Dec 2, 09:00–10:30 or 16:00–17:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side should join (security/IT, data eng, PM)? I’ve looped in Ben to run the technical deep dive. I’ve attached a short mutual action plan (MAP_v1.pdf) with milestones and deliverables.

If those dates don’t work, share two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@healthplus.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Perez <tom.perez@healthplus.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose eval kickoff + prompt workshop

Hey Karthik —

Appreciate the recap and the clear plan. We’re excited to move forward. Tom (data engineering) and I will join; I’ll also try to get one of our security folks on the kickoff but can’t promise until I confirm a headcount.

For the proposed windows, the Wed Dec 2 in the 09:00–10:30 slot works best for us. If you can hold 09:00–10:15 that’s ideal (shorter kickoff + follow-on prompt workshop).

One ask before the kickoff: could you share a rough agenda for the prompt workshop and an example of the prompt pack format? That will help us pick the 200 representative notes.

Thanks —
Sarah
Director, AI Products | HealthPlus AI
sarah.lee@healthplus.ai | (650) 555-4421
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@healthplus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Tom Perez <tom.perez@healthplus.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose eval kickoff + prompt workshop

Great — locking Wed Dec 2, 09:00–10:15 PST for the evaluation kickoff (we’ll keep the session focused and leave time to scope the follow-on prompt workshop).

Draft agenda for the combined kickoff + next steps:
1) 09:00–09:10 — Introductions & success metric confirmation (owners + target thresholds)
2) 09:10–09:30 — Architecture & data flow + security considerations (Ben + Tom)
3) 09:30–09:45 — Eval methodology: prompt pack, dataset sampling, acceptance tests (Karthik)
4) 09:45–10:00 — Prompt workshop planning & roles (identify note subsets and edge-case scenarios)
5) 10:00–10:15 — Milestones, MAP review, and immediate next steps (scheduling prompt workshop + delivery dates)

Attached is a sample prompt pack (prompt_pack_v0.jsonl) — it contains a small set of anonymized note examples and the prompt templates we typically iterate on. Please review and send a short list of typical failure modes you want us to prioritize (e.g., miss-classification of CPT codes, hallucinated diagnoses, truncated notes).

Logistics: I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and include a shared Drive folder (I’ll add the prompt pack and MAP there). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HP-2026-042

If your security lead wants an advance packet, Ben can attach our SOC 2 summary and data handling blurb; say the word and we’ll include it.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: prompt_pack_v0.jsonl (text/plain)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-prompt-set
